name: bonded-app
description: Relationship verification app for immigration success. Privacy-first. AI runs fully in-browser. Storage on ICP blockchain.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd src/bonded-app-frontend && npm install
scripts.test:backend: dfx canister call bonded-app-backend greet '("ICP Backend")'
scripts.dev: npm run start:local && npm run deploy:local && cd src/bonded-app-frontend && npm run start
scripts.deploy:local:fast: npm run frontend:build:fast && dfx deploy bonded-app-frontend --network local --upgrade-unchanged
scripts.deploy:local:minimal: cd src/bonded-app-frontend && npm run build:minimal && cd ../.. && dfx deploy bonded-app-frontend --network local --upgrade-unchanged
scripts.deploy:direct: cd src/bonded-app-frontend && npm run build:ultra-light && cd ../.. && dfx deploy bonded-app-frontend --network local --no-asset-upgrade
scripts.clean: dfx stop || true && rm -rf .dfx src/bonded-app-frontend/dist target

author: Bonded Team
